title: Construct bicrystal simulation cells for Σ3 and Σ9 STGB
action: Construct initial atomic coordinates for Σ3(1-11) and Σ9(2-21) symmetric tilt grain boundaries of aluminum (FCC, a=4.05 Å) using the CSL model with [001] tilt axis. Set periodic boundary conditions in the interface plane and free surfaces normal to it. Output LAMMPS data files.
description: Creation of initial geometries required for all subsequent simulations.

title: Molecular statics energy minimization of STGB cells
action: Perform energy minimization at 0 K using LAMMPS with the Oh-Johnson EAM potential on the constructed bicrystal cells to obtain equilibrium grain boundary structures. Save relaxed coordinates.
description: Equilibrium structures serve as starting points for all sliding/migration simulations.

title: Displacement-controlled pure GBS of Σ3(1-11)
action: For the relaxed Σ3(1-11) bicrystal, apply incremental shear displacements to the top grain (e.g., 1% of a_CSL per step), relax the structure by molecular statics after each increment, and compute the grain boundary energy per unit area. Save the energy versus displacement.
description: Energy profile of pure grain boundary sliding, showing peaks and valleys that characterize the energy barriers.
output_schema: columns: displacement_fraction (float, fraction of a_CSL), gb_energy (float, eV/Å²)

title: Force-controlled MD simulation for Σ3 at 0.02 eV/Å
action: Run molecular dynamics in LAMMPS at constant volume on the relaxed Σ3(1-11) bicrystal, applying a force of 0.02 eV/Å on all atoms in the top grain along the x-direction, for at least 5 ps. Save atomic trajectories.
description: Generates time-dependent trajectory for coupled sliding and migration analysis.

title: Extract sliding displacement vs time for Σ3
action: From the MD trajectory of step 4, compute the average x-displacement of the top grain relative to the bottom grain as a function of time (sliding displacement). Output sliding_vs_time.csv.
description: Quantifies the sliding motion of the grain boundary under applied force.

title: Extract migration distance vs time for Σ3
action: From the same MD trajectory, determine the change in y-position of the grain boundary plane (migration distance) as a function of time. Output migration_vs_time.csv.
description: Quantifies the migration of the boundary plane, showing stepwise increase.

title: Force-controlled MD simulation for Σ3 and Σ9 at multiple force levels
action: Run molecular dynamics for the relaxed Σ3(1-11) and Σ9(2-21) bicrystals with applied force per unit volume of 0.58e-3, 1.17e-3, and 2.32e-3 eV/Å^4 (scale total force on top grain atoms accordingly). Run each simulation for at least 5 ps and save trajectories.
description: Generates trajectories for comparing GB energy and force effects on sliding.

title: Force and GB energy effect on sliding displacement at 5 ps
action: For each MD run from step 07, compute the sliding displacement at 5 ps and write a summary CSV. The CSV must contain columns boundary_label (string), force_per_volume_eV_per_A4 (float, eV/Å^4), and sliding_at_5ps (float, Å). Include rows for all six boundary–force combinations.
description: Shows that higher force per volume leads to larger sliding displacement, and that higher grain boundary energy also produces more sliding.
output_schema: columns: boundary_label (string), force_per_volume_eV_per_A4 (float, eV/Å^4), sliding_at_5ps (float, Å)
